summary: Rabbi Yotav Eliach discusses the current state of antisemitism on college campuses in the wake of the October 7th massacre in Israel. He shares his personal history with campus activism and provides guidance on how the community can effectively respond through education, political engagement, and economic pressure. The discussion emphasizes the unity of Am Yisrael and the importance of understanding the historical and ideological context of the war.
questions: Why is the current situation on college campuses different from previous years?
How should the community respond to anti-Israel rhetoric at universities?
What are the most effective ways to support Israel from the diaspora?
How can we educate ourselves and others about the history of the conflict?
What is the significance of the unity currently seen among the people of Israel?
